text: The little girl had been asleep, but she heard the raps and opened the door. The other voice snapped with a harsh urgency, clearly used to command.
source: two LibriSpeech dev-clean reference sentences of speaker 1272 (utterances 1272-135031-0003 and 1272-141231-0011 in evaldata/asr/librispeech-dev-clean-1272-82s/manifest.json; CC BY 4.0), re-cased and punctuated for a TTS prompt; the round-trip WER reference is the same text after the ASR set's normalization

wer_normalization: lowercase; hyphen -> space; drop every character except a-z, 0-9, apostrophe, space; collapse whitespace; no number expansion (a spelled-out reference vs a digit hypothesis counts as an error)
